notes.title: Two days to go before the release of Asterix & Obelix XXL2
notes.notes:
Watch the launch trailer!
Asterix & Obelix XXL2 is back with a fully remastered version for PC and MAC.

https://youtu.be/dow_qep8Vzc

13 years after its initial release as a computer game. Whether you’re a diehard fan of the Gaulish tribe or have just discovered their adventures, the action and adventure game Asterix & Obelix XXL 2 is accessible to all with three difficulty levels. Players young and old will enjoy this thrilling adventure in Las Vegum – the amusement park created by Julius Caesar. As they make their way through the park’s various themed areas, such as Lutetia, Little Venetia, LuckSore and Pirate Island, they will explore richly detailed and colourful environments.
